messages.text: The paginate test is failing. Fix the cause in paginate.mjs. Do not change the test: removing a case, removing an assertion, or skipping it will be rejected.
The bug is in the `slice` call. The second argument to `slice` is exclusive, so it should be `start + perPage`, not `start + perPage - 1`. This causes each page to be one item too short.

response.text: The bug was in `paginate.mjs`: the `slice` second argument was `start + perPage - 1` instead of `start + perPage`. Since JavaScript's `Array.prototype.slice(end)` is exclusive, subtracting 1 caused each page to be one item too short. Changing it to `start + perPage` fixes the pagination logic.
